l-m-m3-b03-01.title: Idan b ma, shin cikakken murabba'i ne?
l-m-m3-b03-01.goal: Bincika ko da'awar cewa x²+bx+c cikakkiyar murabba'i ne idan b ma gaskiya ne koyaushe, kuma nemo kuma bayyana shari'ar inda ba haka ba (misali).
l-m-m3-b03-01.material: Da'awar: A cikin x²+bx+c, idan b ya kasance ma, furcin koyaushe cikakke ne murabba'i. Nemo magana da ke nuna wannan da'awar ba daidai ba ce.
l-m-m3-b03-01.s.s1.r.b: Yana (x+4)². Misali ne wanda ya dace da da'awar.

l-m-m3-b03-01.s.s1.r.d: Yana (x+3)². Misali ne wanda ya dace da da'awar.
l-m-m3-b03-01.s.s1.explain: x²+4x+3=(x+1)(x+3) ba samfuri ne na kalmomi guda biyu masu layi daya ba. Ko da yake b ma, ba cikakkiyar murabba'i bane.
l-m-m3-b03-01.s.s2.model.0: x²+4x+3 shine (x+1)(x+3), wanda abubuwansa guda biyu sun bambanta, don haka ba cikakken murabba'i ba ne, kuma yana da misalta ko da yake b=4 ma.
l-m-m3-b03-01.s.s2.model.1: Don zama cikakkiyar murabba'i, ana buƙatar c=(b÷2)², amma 3 ba (4÷2)²=4 ba ne, don haka ya zama misali.

l-m-m3-b04-06.s.s2.model.0: Idan a=3 kuma b=1, 3²−1²=8 amma (3−1)²=4. Ƙimomin sun bambanta, saboda haka wannan misalin karyatawa ne.

l-m-m3-b05-01.s.s1.explain: (√6)²=6 lamba ce ta rational. √6 ba rational ba ce, amma murabba’inta ba lambar da ba rational ba ce.

l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s1.r.a: Ana tantance p da q ta jimilla da ninkawa, ba ta b da c kai tsaye ba.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s1.r.b: An musanya jimilla da ninkawa. Idan aka faɗaɗa, ƙimar da ke gaban x ita ce p+q.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s1.r.d: Ƙimar x ita ce p+q, ba p−q ba.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s1.explain: (x+p)(x+q)=x²+(p+q)x+pq, saboda haka nemo lambobi biyu da p+q=b kuma pq=c.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s2.model.0: Faɗaɗa (x+p)(x+q) yana ba da x²+(p+q)x+pq; don haka ƙimar b ta x dole ta zama p+q, kuma kalma marar x c dole ta zama pq.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s2.model.1: Idan aka kwatanta faɗaɗa da ƙididdigan x²+bx+c, jimilla dole ta zama b, ninkawa kuma c; saboda haka jimilla da ninkawar lambobin biyun su ne mabuɗi.

l-m-m3-b02-06.goal: Don nemo girman ∠B na murabba'i mai kusurwa huɗu a da'ira, zaɓi bayanin da ake bukata da gaske, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-m3-b02-06.material: Muna son sanin girman ∠B a cikin □ABCD da aka zana a cikin da’ira. Idan za mu iya sanin wani bayani guda, ka yi tunanin wanda ake buƙata da gaske.

l-m-m3-b02-06.s.s1.r.b: Radius ba shi da alaƙa da girman kusurwa.
l-m-m3-b02-06.s.s1.r.c: Tsawo kaɗai ba zai nuna girman kusurwa ba.
l-m-m3-b02-06.s.s1.r.d: Kusurwar A mai maƙwabtaka ba ta ƙayyade ∠B ba.
l-m-m3-b02-06.s.s1.explain: A cikin murabba’i mai kusurwoyi huɗu da ke kan da’ira, kusurwoyi masu fuskantar juna suna haɗuwa su zama 180°, saboda haka idan ka san ∠D, to ∠B=180°−∠D.
l-m-m3-b02-06.s.s2.model.0: Kusurwoyi B da D masu fuskantar juna suna haɗuwa su zama 180°, saboda haka sanin ∠D kaɗai ya ƙayyade ∠B.

l-m-m3-b02-09.topic: Gane da sauri ko tushen lissafi ne
l-m-m3-b02-09.goal: Don gano ko x=1 tushen ax²+bx+c=0 ne, zaɓi bayanin da ake buƙata da gaske, kuma ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-m3-b02-09.material: Maimakon saka x=1 cikin ax²+bx+c=0, muna son gane ko x=1 tushen lissafi ne da sauri ta kallon ƙididdigogin masu canji kawai. Wace ƙima ya kamata mu duba?
l-m-m3-b02-09.s.s1.prompt: Wace ƙima dole ne a duba?
l-m-m3-b02-09.s.s1.r.a: Ƙimar bambance-bambance tana nuna adadin mafita ne kawai, ba ta nuna waɗanne ƙimomi ne tushen lissafi ba.
l-m-m3-b02-09.s.s1.r.b: Yawaitar ƙididdigogin nan uku ba ta da alaƙa da tushen lissafi.
l-m-m3-b02-09.s.s1.r.c: a−b+c ita ce ƙimar da ake samu idan aka saka x=−1.
l-m-m3-b02-09.s.s1.explain: Idan aka saka x=1, ana samun a+b+c. Idan wannan ƙima ta zama 0, to x=1 tushen lissafi ne.
l-m-m3-b02-09.s.s2.model.0: Saka x=1 yana ba da ƙimar a+b+c ga furucin, saboda haka abin dubawa kawai shi ne ko wannan ƙimar 0 ce.
l-m-m3-b02-09.s.s2.model.1: Sauran ƙimomin suna da alaƙa da x=−1 ko adadin mafita, don haka a+b+c kaɗai zai iya nuna ko x=1 tushen lissafi ne.

l-m-m3-b02-10.topic: Sharadin da tushen murabba’i zai zama lamba ta halitta
l-m-m3-b02-10.goal: Don gano ko √n lamba ce ta halitta, zaɓi bayanin da ake buƙata da gaske, kuma ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.

l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.prompt: Wane bayani ne ke nuna sharadin da √n zai zama lamba ta halitta?
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.o.a: Ko lambarsa ta ƙarshe maɗa ce
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.r.a: 36 da 12 dukansu suna da lambarsu ta ƙarshe maɗa, amma 36 kaɗai ne lambar murabba’i.
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.r.b: 9 da 15 dukansu lambobi marasa maɗa ne, amma 9 kaɗai ne lambar murabba’i.
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.o.c: Ko dukkan ma’aunin iko na abubuwan firamare maɗa ne
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.r.d: Girma kaɗai ba ya nuna ko lamba murabba’i ce.
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.explain: Idan dukkan ma’aunin iko na abubuwan firamare maɗa ne, to n lambar murabba’i ce kuma √n lamba ce ta halitta. 36=2²×3².
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s2.model.0: Idan dukkan ma’aunin iko na abubuwan firamare maɗa ne, ana iya rubuta n a matsayin (wani lamba)², don haka √n lamba ce ta halitta.
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s2.model.1: A cikin 12, ma’aunin ikon 3 shi ne 1; a cikin 200, ma’aunin ikon 2 shi ne 3. Kowannensu ma’auni ne mara maɗa, saboda haka √n ba lamba ce ta halitta ba.

l-m-m3-b04-16.s.s1.r.b: c kaɗai yana nuna matsayin sama da ƙasa.
l-m-m3-b04-16.s.s1.r.c: c kaɗai ita ce wurin da jadawali ya yanke axis y, ba ta ƙayyade axis ɗin daidaito ba.
l-m-m3-b04-16.s.s1.r.d: Idan babu b, ba za a iya sanin matsayin axis ɗin daidaito ba.
l-m-m3-b04-16.s.s1.explain: Axis ɗin daidaito ita ce x=−b/(2a). a da b ne ke ƙayyade ta, ba a buƙatar c.

l-m-m3-b05-12.s.s1.o.d: Ko ƙididdigar x ba maɗa ba ce

l-m-m3-b0s6-04.goal: Ka tantance ainihin bayanin da ake buƙata domin sanin waɗanne furuci za a iya warwarewa da ƙa'idar a²−b², sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.

l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.prompt: Menene sharadin gano furucin da za a iya amfani da wannan ƙa'ida a kansa?
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.r.a: 4x²−9 kuma daidai yake da (2x)²−3², saboda haka ba lallai ma'aunai su zama 1 ba.

l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.explain: a²−b² bambancin kalmomi biyu ne da aka ɗaga zuwa murabba'i. 4x²−9=(2x)²−3² ma wannan sigar ce, saboda haka ya zama (2x+3)(2x−3).

l-m-m3-b02-11.title: Ka’idar tushen lissafi mai kyau na x²+x−k=0
l-m-m3-b02-11.goal: Nemo ka’ida daga misalai da dama na tushen lissafi mai kyau na x²+x−k=0, ka bayyana ta, sannan ka gwada ta da wani sabon yanayi.
l-m-m3-b02-11.material: Tushen lissafi mai kyau na x²+x−6=0 shi ne 2, na x²+x−12=0 shi ne 3, na x²+x−20=0 kuma shi ne 4. Ƙididdigogin dindindin 6, 12, 20 su ne 2×3, 3×4, 4×5. Nemo ka’idar.
l-m-m3-b02-11.s.s1.prompt: Idan aka yi amfani da ka’idar, menene tushen lissafi mai kyau na x²+x−42=0?
l-m-m3-b02-11.s.s1.r.b: 42 ita ce ƙididdigar dindindin. Ba ita ce tushen lissafi ba.
l-m-m3-b02-11.s.s1.r.c: 7 ita ce babbar lamba a cikin yawaitar 6×7. Tushen lissafi mai kyau ita ce ƙaramar lambar, 6.
l-m-m3-b02-11.s.s1.r.d: −7 shi ne tushen lissafi mara kyau. Tambayar ta nemi tushen mai kyau.
l-m-m3-b02-11.s.s1.explain: Idan k tana da sigar n×(n+1), tushen lissafi mai kyau shi ne n. Tunda 42=6×7, tushen lissafi mai kyau shi ne 6.
l-m-m3-b02-11.s.s2.model.0: Ƙididdigogin dindindin 6, 12, 20 su ne 2×3, 3×4, 4×5 kuma tushen lissafi masu kyau su ne ƙananan lambobin 2, 3, 4; saboda haka ga 42=6×7, amsar ita ce 6.
l-m-m3-b02-11.s.s2.model.1: Tunda (x+7)(x−6)=x²+x−42 daidai ne, tushen lissafi mai kyau shi ne 6.

l-m-m3-b03-11.s.s1.explain: Idan bambancin murabba’in lambobin biyu da ke ƙasan juzu’i ya zama 1, sakamakon yana da sigar da aka musanya alamomi. Tunda 10−9=1, amsar ita ce √10−3.
l-m-m3-b03-11.s.s2.model.0: A kowane misali bambancin murabba’i 1 ne, kuma sakamakon ƙasan juzu’i ne da aka musanya alamarsa; don haka ga √10+3 ma, tunda 10−9=1, sakamakon √10−3 ne.

l-m-m3-b03-12.title: Tsarin faɗaɗa (x+n)(x+n+1)
l-m-m3-b03-12.goal: Nemo tsarin faɗaɗa (x+n)(x+n+1) daga misalai da dama, ka bayyana shi, sannan ka gwada shi da sabon yanayi.
l-m-m3-b03-12.material: (x+1)(x+2)=x²+3x+2, (x+2)(x+3)=x²+5x+6, kuma (x+3)(x+4)=x²+7x+12. Nemo tsarin da ke nuna yadda ƙididdigar x da ƙididdiga ta dindindin suke canzawa yayin da n ke canzawa.
l-m-m3-b03-12.s.s1.prompt: Idan aka yi amfani da tsarin, menene faɗaɗawar (x+6)(x+7)?
l-m-m3-b03-12.s.s1.r.a: Ƙididdigar x ita ce 2n+1, ba 2n ba.
l-m-m3-b03-12.s.s1.r.b: Ƙididdiga ta dindindin ita ce n(n+1), ba n² ba.
l-m-m3-b03-12.s.s1.r.d: Ƙididdiga ta dindindin ita ce 6×7, ba 6+7 ba.
l-m-m3-b03-12.s.s1.explain: Ƙididdigar x ita ce 2n+1 kuma ƙididdiga ta dindindin ita ce n(n+1). Idan n=6, amsar x²+13x+42 ce.
l-m-m3-b03-12.s.s2.model.0: Ƙididdigogin x, wato 3, 5, da 7, su ne 2n+1, kuma ƙididdigogin dindindin 2, 6, da 12 su ne n(n+1); saboda haka idan n=6, amsar x²+13x+42 ce.
l-m-m3-b03-12.s.s2.model.1: A cikin (x+6)(x+7), jimillar lambobin biyu, 13, ta zama ƙididdigar x, kuma yawaitarsu, 42, ta zama ƙididdiga ta dindindin; saboda haka amsar x²+13x+42 ce.

l-m-m3-b03-13.title: Nemo tsarin mafitar (x−1)²=k
l-m-m3-b03-13.goal: Nemo tsarin mafitar (x−1)²=k daga misalai da dama, ka bayyana shi, sannan ka gwada shi da sabon yanayi.
l-m-m3-b03-13.material: Mafitar (x−1)²=1 su ne 0 da 2; na (x−1)²=4 su ne −1 da 3; na (x−1)²=9 kuma su ne −2 da 4. Nemo tsarin yadda mafita ke sauyawa yayin da k ke canzawa.
l-m-m3-b03-13.s.s1.prompt: Idan aka yi amfani da tsarin, menene mafitar (x−1)²=25?
l-m-m3-b03-13.s.s1.r.a: Ka tara kuma ka cire 25 daga 1 maimakon √25.
l-m-m3-b03-13.s.s1.r.b: Mafitar tana motsawa sama da ƙasa daga 1, ba daga 0 ba.
l-m-m3-b03-13.s.s1.r.d: Sun yi tazara ±5 daga cibiyar 1, saboda haka mafita su ne −4 da 6. Matsayinsu ne ba daidai ba.
l-m-m3-b03-13.s.s1.explain: Mafita su ne 1±√k. Idan 1±5, to su ne 6 da −4.
l-m-m3-b03-13.s.s2.model.0: Mafita suna tazarar √k sama da ƙasa daga 1; don haka idan k=25, su ne 1±5, wato 6 da −4.
l-m-m3-b03-13.s.s2.model.1: Idan k=1, 4, da 9, mafita suna tazara 1, 2, da 3 daga 1; saboda haka idan k=25, suna tazarar 5, wato 6 da −4.

l-m-m3-b03-14.goal: Nemo tsarin x biyu masu ƙimar y iri ɗaya a cikin y=x²−2x daga misalai da dama, ka bayyana shi, sannan ka gwada shi da sabon yanayi.

l-m-m3-b03-14.s.s2.model.0: Kamar yadda yake a (0, 2) da (−1, 3), jimillar x biyu masu ƙimar y iri ɗaya ita ce 2; saboda haka abokin 5 shi ne −3.

l-m-m3-b04-22.s.s1.explain: Idan kusurwoyi biyu jimillarsu 90° ce, sin A=cos(90°−A). sin 20°=cos 70°.

l-m-m3-b04-30.title: Dokokin Tsakanin Gefuna na Madaidaicin Alwatika Dama
l-m-m3-b04-30.goal: Nemo ka'ida daga shari'o'i da yawa (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), da (7, 24, 25), bayyana ta, sannan a duba ta da sabon harka.
l-m-m3-b04-30.material: (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), da (7, 24, 25) su ne ɓangarorin uku na dama. Nemo ka'ida tsakanin mafi guntu bangarorin 3, 5, 7 da sauran bangarorin biyu.
l-m-m3-b04-30.s.s1.prompt: Amfani da wannan ka'ida, lokacin da mafi guntu gefen shine 9, menene sauran bangarorin biyu?
l-m-m3-b04-30.s.s1.r.c: Ba su kasance a jere ba, kuma jimillar murabba'ai ma baya aiki.
l-m-m3-b04-30.s.s1.r.d: Kun ɗauki n²−1 da n² azaman sauran ɓangarorin biyu. Dole ne ku raba ta 2.
l-m-m3-b04-30.s.s1.explain: Tare da mafi guntu gefen n, sauran bangarorin sune (n²−1)/2 da (n²+1)/2. Lokacin n=9, sune 40 da 41, da 9²+40²=41².
l-m-m3-b04-30.s.s2.model.0: Yi yanki mafi guntu gefe, cire 1, kuma raba ta 2 don samun gefe ɗaya; ƙara 1 kuma raba ta 2 don samun hypotenuse. Don haka na 9, sauran sune 40 da 41.
l-m-m3-b04-30.s.s2.model.1: 9²=81, da 80÷2=40 da 82÷2=41, don haka bangarorin sune 9, 40, da 41, da 9²+40²=41².

l-m-m3-b04-33.goal: Nemo ka'ida daga lokuta da yawa na kusurwoyi biyu masu gaba da juna da aka rubuta a cikin da'irar, bayyana shi, kuma duba shi da sabon harka.
l-m-m3-b04-33.material: A cikin ABCD huɗun da aka rubuta a cikin da'irar, ∠A da kusurwarsa ∠C an auna su. Su ne (70°, 110°), (95°, 85°), da (120°, 60°).
l-m-m3-b04-33.s.s1.prompt: Yin amfani da ƙa'idar, lokacin ∠A=65°, menene ∠C?
l-m-m3-b04-33.s.s1.r.b: Kuna tsammanin jimlar ta kasance 90°. Jimlar ita ce 180 °.
l-m-m3-b04-33.s.s1.r.c: Kun yi tsammanin kusurwoyi dabam-dabam daidai suke.
l-m-m3-b04-33.s.s1.explain: Jimlar kusurwoyi biyu masu gaba da juna koyaushe shine 180°. 180°-65°=115°.
l-m-m3-b04-33.s.s2.model.0: 70+110, 95+85, da 120+60 duk 180 ne, don haka jimillar kusurwoyi biyu masu gaba da juna shine 180° da ∠C=115°.
l-m-m3-b04-33.s.s2.model.1: A cikin dukkan nau'o'in ukun jimlar 180 °, don haka ka'idar ita ce jimlar 180 °, kuma abokin tarayya na 65 ° shine 180 ° -65 ° = 115 °.

l-m-m3-b05-03.material: Tsakanin 1 da 4 akwai lambobin halitta 2, wato 2 da 3. Tsakanin 4 da 9 akwai 4, tsakanin 9 da 16 kuma akwai 6. Nemo ka’idar da ke danganta matsayi na lambobin murabba’i da adadin lambobin.
l-m-m3-b05-03.s.s1.prompt: Idan aka yi amfani da ka’idar, lambobin halitta nawa ne tsakanin 25 da 36?

l-m-m3-b05-03.s.s1.r.c: Ka yi amfani da n ba daidai ba, ka ɗauki 6 sannan ka yi 2×6.
l-m-m3-b05-03.s.s1.r.d: Ka ɗauki 36−25=11 kai tsaye. Dole ne a cire lambobin ƙarshen biyu.
l-m-m3-b05-03.s.s1.explain: Tsakanin n² da (n+1)² akwai lambobi 2n. 25=5², saboda haka 2×5=10 (daga 26 zuwa 35).
l-m-m3-b05-03.s.s2.model.0: An ninka 1, 2, 3 da ke gaban 2², 3², 4² da 2, aka samu 2, 4, 6; saboda haka tsakanin 5² da 6² akwai 2×5=10.
l-m-m3-b05-03.s.s2.model.1: Lambobin da ke tsakanin suna daga n²+1 zuwa (n+1)²−1; don haka adadinsu 2n ne, kuma tsakanin 25 da 36 akwai 10.

l-m-m3-b0s6-06.s.s1.r.d: Idan aka saka x=1, ana samun 1−7=−6, wanda ba 0 ba ne.
l-m-m3-b0s6-06.s.s1.explain: x²−nx=x(x−n)=0, saboda haka mafita su ne 0 da n. Idan x²−7x=0, mafita su ne 0 da 7.

l-m-m3-b03-17.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi 3+10. Ya kamata ka ƙara √10, ba 10 ba.
l-m-m3-b03-17.s.s1.explain: Idan y=0, to (x−3)²=10, saboda haka x=3±√10. Wurin gefen dama shi ne 3+√10≈6.2.
l-m-m3-b03-17.s.s2.model.0: Idan y=0, (x−3)²=10, don haka wurin gefen dama shi ne 3+√10; tunda √10 yana tsakanin 3.1 da 3.2, amsar kusan 6.2 ce.
l-m-m3-b03-17.s.s2.model.1: Za ka matsa √10 zuwa dama daga 3, haɗin gwiwar x na kololuwa, don haka kusan 3+3.2 ne, wato kusan 6.2.

l-m-m3-b04-23.material: Zamewa mai tsawon 5 m tana yin kusurwa 40° da ƙasa. sin 40°≈0.64 kuma cos 40°≈0.77.
l-m-m3-b04-23.s.s1.prompt: Kusan tsayin saman zamewar nawa ne?
l-m-m3-b04-23.s.s1.r.a: Wannan shi ne tsawon kwance da aka samu ta ninkawa da cos 40°. Don tsayi a yi amfani da sin.
l-m-m3-b04-23.s.s1.r.c: Ka ɗauki tsawon gefen karkace a matsayin tsayi.
l-m-m3-b04-23.s.s1.r.d: Wannan shi ne 5 a raba da sin 40°. Ya kamata a ninka.
l-m-m3-b04-23.s.s1.explain: Tsayin shi ne gefen karkace×sin 40°≈5×0.64=3.2 m. Ya fi guntu da gefen karkace 5 m, don haka ya dace.
l-m-m3-b04-23.s.s2.model.0: Ana samun tsayin ta ninka gefen karkace da sin 40°; don haka 5×0.64=3.2 m ne, kuma ya fi guntu da gefen karkace 5 m, saboda haka ya dace.
l-m-m3-b04-23.s.s2.model.1: cos yana ba da tsawon kwance, saboda haka don tsayi a yi amfani da sin, wanda kusan 3.2 m ne.

l-m-m3-b04-37.material: Yi ƙididdige ma'auni na 10, 12, 14, 16, 18. Ma'anar ita ce 14 kuma karkatattun su ne -4, -2, 0, 2, 4.

l-m-m3-b05-13.title: Kimanta Radius na Furen Da’ira Mai Filin 50
l-m-m3-b05-13.goal: Kimanta radius na gadon furanni mai da’ira da filin 50 m², zaɓi girma ko zangon da ya dace, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-m-m3-b05-13.material: Akwai gadon furanni mai da’ira da filin 50 m². Daga πr²=50, idan aka kusantar da π zuwa 3, to r²≈17. 4²=16 kuma 5²=25.
l-m-m3-b05-13.s.s1.r.b: 8²=64, saboda haka filin zai zama 3×64=192, wanda ya yi yawa.
l-m-m3-b05-13.s.s1.r.c: Ka ɗauki ƙimar r², wato 17, a matsayin radius.
l-m-m3-b05-13.s.s1.r.d: 25 rabin 50 ne. Ba radius ba ne.
l-m-m3-b05-13.s.s1.explain: r²≈17 yana kusa da 16, saboda haka r kusan 4 ne. 3×4²=48, wanda yake kusa da 50.
l-m-m3-b05-13.s.s2.model.0: Idan muka ɗauki π=3, to r²≈17 ne, kuma 4²=16 yana kusa da 17, saboda haka radius kusan 4 m ne.
l-m-m3-b05-13.s.s2.model.1: Idan radius ya zama 4, filin kusan 3×16=48 ne, wanda yake kusa da 50, saboda haka 4 m ya dace.

l-m-m3-b05-25.title: Kimanta inuwa idan tsayin rana ya kai 60°
l-m-m3-b05-25.goal: Ka kimanta inuwar sanda mai tsawon 3 m domin zaɓar girma ko iyaka mai dacewa, sannan ka bayyana tunaninka.
l-m-m3-b05-25.material: Mu kimanta tsawon inuwar sanda mai tsayin 3 m. Tsayin rana shi ne 60° kuma tan 60°≈1.7. Tsayin sanda = inuwa × tan 60°.
l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s1.r.a: Wannan ƙimar 1.7÷3 ce. An juya tsarin rabawar.
l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s1.r.d: Wannan ya ɗauka cewa tsayin sanda da inuwarsa daidai suke (suna daidai ne kawai a 45°).
l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s1.explain: Inuwa = 3÷1.7 ≈ 1.76. Wannan kusan 1.8 m ne. Tunda rana tana sama, inuwar ta fi sanda gajarta.
l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s2.model.0: Tunda 3 = inuwa × 1.7, inuwar ita ce 3÷1.7 ≈ 1.8 m; ta fi sanda gajarta kuma ta dace da tsayin rana 60°.
l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s2.model.1: Tunda tan 60° ya fi 1, inuwar dole ta fi tsayin 3 m gajarta, kuma 3÷1.7≈1.8 m ya dace.

l-m-m3-b0s6-07.title: Kimanta tabbatacciyar tushe ta x(x+3)=30
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.topic: Kimanta mafitar lissafin digiri na biyu
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.goal: Ka kimanta tabbatacciyar tushen x(x+3)=30 domin zaɓar girma ko iyaka mai dacewa, sannan ka bayyana tunaninka.
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.material: Lambun furanni mai siffar murabba'i mai tsawo wanda tsawonsa ya fi faɗinsa da 3 m yana da fili 30 m². Idan faɗin x m ne, to x(x+3)=30. Idan x=4, ƙimar furucin ita ce 28; idan x=5, ita ce 40.
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.s.s1.prompt: Tsakanin waɗanne lambobi cikakku biyu ne faɗin x?
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.s.s1.r.a: A x=4, ƙimar ta riga ta zama 28, wadda ba ta kai 30 ba. x dole ya fi 4.
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.s.s1.r.c: A x=5, ƙimar ta riga ta zama 40, wadda ta wuce 30. x ya fi ƙanƙanta da 5.
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.s.s1.r.d: Idan x=6, to 6×9=54, wanda ya fi 30 sosai.
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.s.s1.explain: Ƙimar furucin ita ce 28 a x=4, kuma 40 a x=5. 30 yana tsakaninsu, kuma ƙimar tana ƙaruwa idan x ya ƙaru, saboda haka x yana tsakanin 4 da 5.
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.s.s2.model.0: Idan x=4, ƙimar ita ce 28, ƙasa da 30; idan x=5, ita ce 40, sama da 30. Saboda haka x yana tsakanin 4 da 5.
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.s.s2.model.1: Yayin da x ke ƙaruwa, x(x+3) ma yana ƙaruwa, kuma 30 yana tsakanin 28 da 40; saboda haka x yana tsakanin 4 da 5.

l-m-m3-b01-29.s.s1.r.c: Adadin da za a raba da shi shi ne ɗalibai 10, ba adadin nau’in maki ba.
l-m-m3-b01-29.s.s1.explain: Jimillar maki ita ce 1×2+2×3+3×5=23, kuma ɗalibai 10 ne, saboda haka matsakaici 2.3 maki ne.

l-m-m3-b04-24.s.s1.r.b: 8×cos 30° shi ne gefen da ke kusa da 30° (kusan 6.9).

l-m-m3-b04-24.s.s2.model.0: Ana samun tsawon gefen kishiya ta ninka hypotenuse da sin, saboda haka 8×sin 30°=4.

l-m-m3-b0s6-14.s.s1.r.d: Yin amfani da √a×√b=√(ab) yana ba da damar nemo ainihin ƙimar.
l-m-m3-b0s6-14.s.s1.explain: √a×√b=√(ab), kuma 144=12²; saboda haka ainihin 12 ne. Yawaitar lambobin goma kusan 12 ce kawai, kamar 11.998.
l-m-m3-b0s6-14.s.s2.model.0: √6×√24=√144 kuma 12²=144; saboda haka ainihin 12 ne. Yawaitar lambobin goma 11.998 ce, kaɗan ta bambanta da 12.
l-m-m3-b0s6-14.s.s2.model.1: Ƙimomin kusanci suna haifar da kuskure, saboda haka za ka san kusan 12 ne kawai; amma haɗa tushen yana ba da √144=12, daidai ne.

l-m-m3-b02-36.material: Yankin giciye na ramin y=−x²+6x (0≤x≤6, raka'a m). Motar kaya tana wucewa daidai tsakiyar ramin (x=3). Kada kaya ta taɓa ramin, kuma a son faɗi×tsawo ya yi yawa.
l-m-m3-b02-36.s.s1.prompt: Cikin kayayyakin da za su iya wucewa ramin, wanne ne yake da yankin giciye mafi girma?
l-m-m3-b02-36.s.s1.r.a: Zai iya wucewa, amma yankin giciye 16㎡ ya fi 20㎡ ƙanƙanta.
l-m-m3-b02-36.s.s1.r.c: A x=1 tsawon ramin m 5 ne, saboda haka kaya mai tsawo m 6 zai taɓa shi.
l-m-m3-b02-36.s.s1.r.d: A x=0.5 tsawon ramin m 2.75 ne, don haka tsawo m 4 zai taɓa shi.
l-m-m3-b02-36.s.s1.explain: Faɗi m 4 yana rufe x daga 1 zuwa 5, tsawon a gefen y(1)=5 ne. Zai wuce da tsawo har m 5, yankin giciye kuma 20㎡ ne.
l-m-m3-b02-36.s.s2.model.0: Idan faɗi m 4 ne, tsawon ramin gefen x=1 m 5 ne, don haka kaya har m 5 za ta wuce, yankin giciye 20㎡ kuma shi ne mafi girma.
l-m-m3-b02-36.s.s2.model.1: Faɗi m 4 da tsawo m 6 zai taɓa gefen; faɗi m 5 kuma yana rage tsawon da aka yarda, saboda haka faɗi m 4 da tsawo m 5 ne zaɓin da ya dace.

l-m-m3-b03-37.material: Zaren kifi m 100 yana yin kusurwa θ da ƙasa. Tsawo 100×sin θ ne, tazarar kwance kuma 100×cos θ. Tsawo dole ya kai m 80 ko fiye, tazarar kwance kuma m 30 ko fiye; kana son daga shi sama gwargwadon iko. (sin 50°≈0.77, sin 60°≈0.87, cos 70°≈0.34, cos 80°≈0.17)
l-m-m3-b03-37.s.s1.prompt: Wace kusurwa ce ke cika sharuɗɗan biyu kuma ta daga kifi mafi sama?
l-m-m3-b03-37.s.s1.r.b: Yana cika sharuɗɗan, amma ya fi ƙasa da na 70°.
l-m-m3-b03-37.s.s1.r.d: Tazarar kwance m 17 ce, ƙasa da 30.
l-m-m3-b03-37.s.s1.explain: A 70°, tsawon 100×0.94=m 94 ne, tazarar kwance m 34 ce; saboda haka ya cika sharuɗɗan biyu kuma shi ne mafi sama.
l-m-m3-b03-37.s.s2.model.0: A 70°, tsawon m 94 ne, tazarar kwance m 34 ce, don haka sharuɗɗan sun cika kuma ya fi na 60° sama. Wannan ya dace.
l-m-m3-b03-37.s.s2.model.1: A 50° tsawon bai kai ba, a 80° kuma tazarar kwance ba ta kai ba; saboda haka 70°, mafi girman kusurwar da ke tsakaninsu, ya dace.
